ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the central base and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a central core radiating outward along the trailing edge and forming a mottled boundary against the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits deeper, more irregular pixel-amplitude variations compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curvature sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse, dark circular pixel clusters visible on the lower-inner margins of both white lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent dark vertical linear mark is visible on the center-left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged irregularity and possible tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly pronounced on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'comma-shaped' mark on the upper-left lobe white field.
